subject.title: fix(pdf): PDF analysis fails for plugin-provided and bundled-catalog models

question: Should PDF analysis switch to the shared async resolver with bundled static-catalog fallback now, accepting the bounded provider-routing and auth-storage compatibility risk?
rationale: The patch is the clean owner-boundary fix and has no actionable findings, but the changed path controls provider/model selection and runtime API-key storage for existing PDF configurations.

options.title: Land With Shared Resolver Proof
options.body: Accept the bounded compatibility risk because the PR converges PDF on the resolver already used by image/main paths and preserves provider-prefixed registry IDs.

options.title: Ask For Broader Provider Proof
options.body: Require one more live PDF run against a different configured provider before merge if maintainers want more provider-matrix confidence.

options.title: Pause For Resolver Owner Review
options.body: Route the PR to shared resolver/media-tool owners first if maintainers want explicit ownership sign-off before changing PDF provider routing.

recommendation.title: Land With Shared Resolver Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded compatibility risk because the PR converges PDF on the resolver already used by image/main paths and preserves provider-prefixed registry IDs.
